description: A Word-like "Open document" dialog over an ITempoDocumentLibraryProvider: an XLarge modal with a collapsible WAI-ARIA folder tree (one roving tab stop, arrow keys), a right-pane breadcrumb (home icon, › separators), a searchable list/grid of documents with a sort indicator, always-visible actions (Rename/Delete disabled until a document is selected), an optional virtual "Recent" node (ShowRecent) and a link-or-copy choice presented as radio cards. Emits a DocumentOpenResult on confirm. The dialog measures its own body: in a container narrower than 768 px (or with LayoutMode=Tablet/Mobile) the tree narrows and Cancel / Open take their own footer row. Colours come only from canonical core tokens (--tm-color-primary, --tm-color-primary-subtle, --tm-color-surface-hover, --tm-text-primary, --tm-color-danger(-subtle), --tm-bg-surface-secondary), so the accent follows the default blue, the opt-in indigo theme and dark mode; there is no hex fallback.

parameters.name: DefaultMode
parameters.description: Initial insert mode. Defaults to <see cref="DocumentOpenMode.Link"/>.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: Which kind of documents to list.

parameters.name: OnSelected
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen document when the user confirms.

parameters.name: OpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog opens or closes.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Page size for browsing. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: ShowRecent
parameters.description: Adds a virtual "Recent" node above the folder tree. Selecting it browses with FolderPath = null, SortField = Modified, Descending = true and Take = PageSize through the existing ITempoDocumentLibraryProvider.BrowseAsync - no provider member is added. Which documents a null folder returns is the provider's decision (the query contract says null or / lists the root, so a provider that wants a library-wide recent list must treat null as everywhere; the demo store returns the root documents only). Opt-in.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto measures the dialog body and goes compact (narrow tree, footer buttons on their own row) below 768 px; Tablet and Mobile force the compact layout and Desktop the wide one without importing the observer script, so a test or a host renders a layout without a DOM.

parameters.name: SearchDebounceMs
parameters.description: Search debounce in milliseconds. Defaults to 300; set 0 in tests.

parameters.name: ShowModeToggle
parameters.description: Whether to offer the link-or-copy choice. Defaults to true.
